map.→ 打开应用名生成器工具: -> Open the app name generator tool
map.为海外版本准备英文名：在中文候选基础上生成可读的英文/拼音组合，便于后续查域名与: Preparing English names for an overseas version: generate readable English and pinyin combinations from the Chinese candidates to make it easier to check domains and trademarks later.
map.仅作灵感与候选，正式上线前务必查商标（中国商标网/USPTO）、应用商店重名与域: Only for inspiration and candidates; before going live always check trademarks (China Trademark Network or USPTO), for name collisions in app stores and domain availability, to avoid infringement or rejection.
map.做 A/B 命名测试：一次产出多个风格（极简/叠词/功能型），供团队投票或用户调: Run an A/B naming test: produce several styles at once (minimal, reduplicated, descriptive) for the team to vote on or for user research.
map.创业或内部项目立项时起名：给定核心词（如「笔记/效率」），组合生成易记、易读的应: Naming at the start of a venture or internal project: given a core word (such as "notes" or "productivity"), combine and generate memorable, readable app names for a candidate list before publishing on the App Store or Android stores.
map.商店搜索与图标下方展示空间有限，2~4 个汉字或不超过 12 个字母最易记；过长: Space below the icon in store search is limited, so 2 to 4 Chinese characters or no more than 12 letters are easiest to remember; anything longer gets truncated and is hard to pass on by word of mouth.
map.生成的应用名能直接用吗？: Can the generated app name be used directly?
map.结合行业关键词与命名风格随机生成APP应用名称并附带简短释义，辅助产品立项与品牌: Randomly generates app names with brief explanations from industry keywords and a naming style, supporting product ideation and brand brainstorming; results are generated locally and are never uploaded.
map.：关键词填「笔记、效率」，风格选「功能型」，生成「速记星、NoteFlow、闪记: : Enter the keywords "notes, efficiency" and pick the "functional" style to generate candidates such as "QuickNote Star, NoteFlow, FlashNote, EfficiencyBox"; among them NoteFlow reads well in English and the domain note-flow.com is most likely unregistered, so it suits an overseas version name.
